mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone, u.shop_id AS shopId, s.shop_name AS shopName, u.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, u.status, u.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN shop s ON u.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON u.warehouse_id = w.id
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.realName}, '%')
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.userKeyWord}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.userKeyWord}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.userKeyWord}, '%') )
AND ( s.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.storeWarehouseKeyword}, '%') OR w.warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.storeWarehouseKeyword}, '%') )
AND u.status = #{params.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
